description: Department of Wildlife Conservation - Order under Fauna & Flora Protection Ordinance that the area of Land in extent 35 Hectares within the Nikaweratiya D/S/D shall be called as the ''Kotuaththawala Sanctuary"
reasoning: This gazette content establishes a new legal/regulatory framework by declaring a specific land area as a protected sanctuary under the Fauna and Flora Protection Ordinance. It exercises statutory powers to create a legally protected area with defined boundaries, making it a regulatory action rather than a government personnel change, organizational restructuring, or land transaction. The mention of the minister's name is incidental to the legal declaration rather than constituting a personnel appointment with detailed portfolio responsibilities.
